description: Gold labels for fixtures/evaluation/cases.json. Read by the scorer only after every arm has produced its outputs; never placed in agent-visible context. 'affected' = the physical product (per the constructed label/register truth) carries a (GTIN, lot) pair listed in notice 2026-04-0331. It is the expected interpretation of constructed evidence, not proof of contamination. expectedBefore = correct status from the register alone; expectedAfter = correct status after the targeted label photo is read and confirmed (null when no evidence step applies). evidenceSufficient = whether a correctly read label photo should, by itself, resolve the case.
